title: Ultrasound-guided Intermediate Cervical Plexus Block
brief_summary: The investigators test with the present study design, whether an ultrasound-guided blockade of the cervical plexus in combination with an additional application of local anesthetic to the superficial cervical ansa (facial nerve: cervical branch) leads to an improved quality of anesthesia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* internal carotid stenosis: open surgical revascularization
* age over 18 years
* written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy (local anesthetics)
* pregnancy
* participation in other studies
* drug addiction
* non-cooperative patients
